output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply and mintedAmount are added without checking if the total supply exceeds the maximum value a uint256 can store, causing a stable value trap where users' assets are frozen.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if the balance of the sender is large enough, causing the sender's funds to be lost.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if the balance of the recipient is large enough, causing the recipient's funds to be lost.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowance mapping is incremented without checking, allowing the owner to set the allowance to a very high value, draining funds from the approved user.
